openings.claim: Pencil assigned pattern and exact quantities on envelopes; mark quantities only after filling. This develops tagged-tray guidance, integrates checking and makes assignments visible.
openings.discriminator: Quantity confusion predicts fewer shared-material omissions with checklists. Matched local-material batches eliminating omissions while correctly used shared-tray checklists retain them defeat this explanation.
openings.probe: Compare equal matched-mixture batches: incumbent, shared trays with checks, local loose materials without checks. Alternate order; independently audit contents; tally preparation, filling, checking time, omissions and crossing reaches.
openings.uncertainty: Small-batch mixture is unknown; omissions may originate during picking or filling. Exact quantities must be available. Pilot effects may not survive scale or later supply depletion.

openings.claim: Keep tagged shared picking; actively compare every envelope against its pattern sample before closure, moving existing checking into assembly.
openings.discriminator: Reference-use improvement predicts complete checked kits despite persistent crossing. Shared-tray interference predicts continuing errors or delays. Multiple incorrect completed kits or exceeding 18 minutes defeats the immediate pilot prediction.
openings.probe: Assemble 12 kits in intended pattern proportions within 18 minutes, including preparation and checking. Document sample use, caught corrections, residual errors and crossing reaches; stop at 18 minutes and count unfinished kits as failure.
openings.uncertainty: Samples must accurately represent quantities and dimensions; intended proportions must be established. Sample access and opened-packet footprint on the table remain unverified.

lineage.reason: Retains checklist, exterior assignment and access-rival comparison.
Retains mandatory sample comparison and timed defeat criterion.

decision: Probe both; improvement is unobserved and records are synthetic. Preserve specified pattern quantities and dimensions; use exactly two volunteers, existing envelopes and supplies, no purchases or equipment, and the 180-by-75-centimetre table. Verify placement and count preparation within 90 minutes. Passing pilots still require all 60 assigned-pattern kits ready before the workshop within 90 minutes, with at most one distribution correction.
